moments.author: Geoff Schwartz
moments.quote: “You have to release Butker after this game. His job is making kicks. He doesn’t make them anymore.”
moments.why: Brutal take from a former NFL lineman as Chiefs kicker Harrison Butker missed two back‑to‑back long FGs and got booed off the field.

moments.author: Michael F. Florio
moments.why: NFL analyst sums up widespread frustration after Butker’s continued kicking woes, amplifying online outrage.

moments.author: Chiefs K Harrison Butker
moments.quote: “It’s part of it. I’m booing myself sometimes. … That’s what you sign up for. I gotta be better.”
moments.why: Rare self‑aware statement from Butker acknowledging fan frustration and personal pressure amid his slump.

moments.author: Andy Reid
moments.quote: “I’m not making any… That’ll be the answer that you get. I’m not making any…”
moments.why: Chiefs head coach preemptively addresses Butker’s performance without committing to a change, fueling speculation.

moments.author: Various
moments.quote: Harrison Butker booed loudly as he ran off the field; some fans even threw beers.
moments.why: Visual of crowd revulsion—a rare heat from fans toward a veteran kicker, going viral across sports coverage.
